overall_assessment: Read all eight random-control plans in full and reviewed all three failed-fetch entries; there were no suspects or pre-pass flags. The plans retain substantive sections, facts boxes and readable structure, but four of eight include exam-schedule boilerplate missed by the pre-pass. Current-plan dates are consistent with plan_years=current, omitted Leganto buttons and staff cards do not establish missing plan content, and the failed-fetch URLs follow the expected MF pattern without evidence of a URL error.

findings.description: PED5610, PED1010, SAM2080L and RL1013 retain Eksamensdatoer schedule blocks with session labels, dates, clock times, withdrawal deadlines and result-publication dates. course_plan_spec.md explicitly excludes MF exam schedules, whose assessment forms are already given in the substantive assessment section; these blocks add recurring non-plan text even though the junk pre-pass flagged nothing.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The MF selector article .content-body in R/institution_config.R includes the exam-schedule block. Its exclude rules remove staff cards, buttons and library widgets, but do not remove Eksamensdatoer; R/blocks.R and page_fulltext() therefore serialize it with the plan.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an MF-specific structural exclusion in R/institution_config.R for the schedule container headed Eksamensdatoer, bounded by that container or the next peer heading. Preserve Avsluttende vurdering/eksamen and its assessment forms, weights and durations, as well as the facts-box Semester field; rebuild extracted_text from the stored harvest.
